about: Demo v2 (t_d31fda2a): the demo's cars and properties. Real, popular cars (no VIN) and famous public / commercial Los Angeles landmarks (never a home). Each valuation was pulled ONCE by scripts/demo_valuations_pull.py and is frozen here; build_demo.py only reads this file and never calls an API. Each car / landmark also has a real Wikimedia Commons photo (scripts/demo_photos_pull.py, demo/photos/), and for the cars an odometer and the published specs of that model; the Carfax / Redfin rows and the value history the demo shows are built around the frozen value (build_demo.apply_assets) and say so in the demo's banner (synthetic data).
